scope: Actual acquired lease duration from the committed acquisition journal; real worker configuration and queue processing, not an empty-queue range observation

cases.name: lease_huge_integer
cases.completion_sql: SELECT count(*)=3 AND bool_and(c.revoke_retry_count=1 AND c.refresh_lease_owner IS NULL) FROM issuance_service.synthetic_revocation_acquisitions a JOIN issuance_service.canvas_oauth_connections c ON c.id=a.connection_id

lease_journal_sql: SELECT jsonb_agg(extract(epoch FROM acquired_expires_at-acquired_updated_at)::float8 ORDER BY ordinal) FROM issuance_service.synthetic_revocation_acquisitions
case_before_start_sql: ALTER TABLE issuance_service.synthetic_revocation_acquisitions ADD COLUMN acquired_expires_at timestamptz, ADD COLUMN acquired_updated_at timestamptz

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION issuance_service.synthetic_observe_revocation_acquisition() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ BEGIN INSERT INTO issuance_service.synthetic_revocation_acquisitions (connection_id,acquired_expires_at,acquired_updated_at) VALUES (NEW.id,NEW.refresh_lease_expires_at,NEW.updated_at); RETURN NEW; END $$
